mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mis_stock WHERE del_flag = '0' AND goods_id = #{goodsId} AND (batch_no = #{batchNo} OR (batch_no IS NULL AND #{batchNo} IS NULL)) AND warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND (area_id = #{areaId} OR (area_id IS NULL AND #{areaId} IS NULL)) AND (shelf_id = #{shelfId} OR (shelf_id IS NULL AND #{shelfId} IS NULL)) AND (location_id = #{locationId} OR (location_id IS NULL AND #{locationId} IS NULL)) LIMIT 1
